items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And that's where I met Clifford Brown. He was working with Chris Columbus.

ctx.x: So there was what, a sprinkling of jazz-oriented musicians, and then what, classically oriented musicians? All playing together?

Uh-huh. Now, the year that I graduated, that was the bandmaster's last year there. Then they had a black conductor, Brown, Professor Brown. Now, he had fellows in his band, like Lamar Wright, Jr., Dexter Garden, Lawrence Marabel, all of that age category.
They were just one year behind you?
